events.text: Goal! Fulham 1, Crystal Palace 0. Josh King (Fulham) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a fast break.
Goal! Fulham 1, Crystal Palace 1. Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Eddie Nketiah following a fast break.
Goal! Fulham 2, Crystal Palace 1. César Palacios (Fulham) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Jørgen Strand Larsen replaces Eddie Nketiah because of an injury.
Goal! Fulham 2, Crystal Palace 2. Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Fulham. Sander Berge replaces César Palacios.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Will Hughes replaces Quinten Timber.
Substitution, Crystal Palace. Ben Chilwell replaces Tyrick Mitchell because of an injury.
Goal! Fulham 2, Crystal Palace 3. Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Daichi Kamada.
Substitution, Fulham. Ryan Sessegnon replaces Antonee Robinson.
Substitution, Fulham. Hugo Larsson replaces Oscar Bobb.
Substitution, Fulham. Emile Smith Rowe replaces Shea Charles.
Substitution, Fulham. Rodrigo Muniz replaces Alex Iwobi.

Substitution, Crystal Palace. Darío Osorio replaces Daichi Kamada.
